  Calculation$classicalComparison$curves, "steel"
)
PLOT.SC100 <- buildCalculationClassicalComparisonFigure(
  Calculation$classicalComparison$curves, "shotcrete"
)
PLOT.SC150 <- buildCalculationClassicalComparisonFigure(
  Calculation$classicalComparison$curves, "reinforcedConcrete"
)
